body.statement: For every array satisfying the growth, fraction, boundedness, and nondegeneracy conditions, \[G_n\sigma_n^2=R_n-\rho E_{\tau,1,n}+o(1).\] More precisely, \(G_nC_{\tau\tau,n}+\rho E_{\tau,1,n}\to0\) and \(C_{11,n}/p_n+C_{00,n}/(1-p_n)\to0\); all Johnson degrees \(k\ge2\) vanish at the \(G_n\)-scale uniformly over the bounded schedules.
body.justification: The degree-one projection is the unique first-order memory of finite-pool competition in a dense random partition.
body.gap: FuSamiiWang2026 proves only the sparse limit obtained after replacing the entire disjoint tuple by independent groups; Filmus2016 does not propagate the spectrum through treatment randomization.
body.consumer: The phase formula determines the correct standard error scale whenever a positive fraction of eligible units is assigned to interacting groups.
